title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, Oct 19 - Mohammad Mokhber, Advisor and Aide to Iran's Supreme Leader made remarks in an speech
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, Oct 19 - Mohammad Mokhber, Advisor and Aide to Iran's Supreme Leader made remarks in an speech"

""
"----------"

"SOT1, Mohammad Mokhber, Advisor and Aide to Iran's Supreme Leader (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:17): "Today, we control a strait [Hormuz] that has brought billions of people worldwide to their current predicament. The entire world is now facing serious problems in supplying natural gas, oil, gasoline, and other fuels. Factories are being shut down, and agriculture is being shut down."

""
"SOT2, Mohammad Mokhber, Advisor and Aide to Iran's Supreme Leader (Farsi) (0:18 - 00:45): "Our main deterrent today is the Strait of Hormuz, a point where the United States and even the regime [Israel] cannot bring all their capabilities to bear. They want to strike our power plants; we can reach the power plants of nine countries. They want to strike our petrochemical plants; we can reach the petrochemical plants of nine countries. The Qatari LPG facility that was struck has already caused problems for the entire world.""

""
"SOT3, Mohammad Mokhber, Advisor and Aide to Iran's Supreme Leader (Farsi) (00:46 - 01:09): "The cost of the war has reached a point at which our enemies have been truly humiliated. They do not know what to do. In fact, 70 percent of Americans oppose this war, and Trump’s popularity in America has reached an unprecedented low.
